units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 12</cite> <he>קִירְדְּסָן שפן וכ׳</he> (not <he>קורדסן שהן</he>) if he scraped or planed them and made vessels of them; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:15">ib. VII, 15</cite> <he>קִרְדְּסָן שהן</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:2:10">Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיְקַרְדֵּס</he> (not <he>דם …</he>) until he scrapes (the stones). V. <cite ref="S02011"><he>קִרְטֵס</he></cite>.
